keystones: Olivia Voldaren; Edgar Markov; Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage; Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord
core_cards: Captivating Vampire; Voldaren Bloodcaster // Bloodbat Summoner; Indulgent Aristocrat; Stensia Masquerade; Bloodtithe Harvester; Voldaren Ambusher; Falkenrath Gorger
rationale: Three lords plus Edgar's eminence over a deep aggressive Vampire curve; Blood tokens bridge into Madness.
pitch: An aggressive BR tribe with a bloodthirsty, gothic vibe. Three Vampire lords and Edgar Markov build a fast curve while Blood tokens bridge into Madness synergies. For players who want a sleek, menacing aggro deck with plenty of synergy.

keystones: Falkenrath Gorger; Bloodhall Priest; Asylum Visitor
core_cards: Fiery Temper; Alchemist's Greeting; Murderous Compulsion; Gisa's Bidding; Stromkirk Occultist; Faithless Looting; Lightning Axe; Collective Brutality; Reforge the Soul
rationale: Ten madness cards meet Blood tokens, looting, and escalate-discard costs; hellbent payoffs reward the empty hand.
pitch: A BR aggro deck that turns discarding cards into free spells. Fiery Temper and friends cast at a discount off looting and Blood tokens, and hellbent payoffs love your empty hand. For players who enjoy reckless, fast, cost-cutting sequencing.

keystones: Gisa and Geralf; Grimgrin, Corpse-Born; Necroduality; Gravecrawler
core_cards: Rooftop Storm; Archghoul of Thraben; Bladestitched Skaab; Invasion of Innistrad // Deluge of the Dead; Overcharged Amalgam; Ghoulish Procession; Haunted Dead
rationale: Inherently recursive tribe (Gravecrawler, undying, self-return) converted into board dominance by lords and engines.
pitch: A UB tribe that just refuses to stay dead. Gravecrawler and undying bodies recur endlessly while Gisa and Geralf and Grimgrin turn them into a dominant board. For players who love grinding, resilient, self-recurring armies.

keystones: Mausoleum Wanderer; Spell Queller; Nebelgast Herald
core_cards: Battleground Geist; Spectral Shepherd; Lantern Bearer // Lanterns' Lift; Twinblade Geist // Twinblade Invocation; Essence Flux; Lingering Souls; Tamiyo, Field Researcher
rationale: Flying flash bodies that disrupt while clocking; Tamiyo (cross-tag) draws off evasive attackers connecting.
pitch: A WU tempo deck full of flying flash threats. Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller disrupt the opponent while evasive Spirits clock them out. For players who like slippery beatdown backed by counters and tricks.

keystones: Huntmaster of the Fells // Ravager of the Fells; Arlinn Kord // Arlinn, Embraced by the Moon; Mayor of Avabruck // Howlpack Alpha; Kruin Outlaw // Terror of Kruin Pass
core_cards: Geier Reach Bandit // Vildin-Pack Alpha; Garruk Relentless // Garruk, the Veil-Cursed; Howlpack Resurgence; Moonlight Hunt; Runebound Wolf; Ulrich's Kindred
rationale: Full curve of flip werewolves plus payoffs counting Wolves and Werewolves; Garruk's Wolf tokens (cross-tag) feed those counts.
pitch: A RG midrange tribe that flips into huge threats when the game slows. Transforming werewolves like Huntmaster of the Fells swing games while payoffs count your growing pack. For players who like beefy creatures with a transforming payoff.

keystones: Thalia, Heretic Cathar; Odric, Lunarch Marshal; Torens, Fist of the Angels; Wedding Announcement // Wedding Festivity
core_cards: Hamlet Captain; Dawnhart Disciple; Thraben Inspector; Gather the Townsfolk; Hanweir Garrison; Mentor of the Meek; Butcher's Cleaver
rationale: Widest tribe: cheap bodies, two Human-token engines, Human-specific rewards (Cleaver lifelink, Mayor's anthem), Odric keyword soup.
pitch: A wide, aggressive GW tribe with the deepest creature pool in the cube. Cheap Humans, token engines, and lords like Odric flood the board and pile on keywords. For players who love classic go-wide aggro.

keystones: The Meathook Massacre; Blood Artist; Skirsdag High Priest; Westvale Abbey // Ormendahl, Profane Prince
core_cards: Morbid Opportunist; Fleshtaker; Village Rites; Falkenrath Torturer; Ulvenwald Mysteries; Liesa, Forgotten Archangel; Zealous Conscripts; Archangel Avacyn // Avacyn, the Purifier
rationale: Deepest cluster (59 tagged): death payoffs, free outlets, recursive fodder; Zealous Conscripts (cross-tag) turns any outlet into removal.
pitch: The deepest sacrifice deck in the cube, turning dying creatures into drain and value. The Meathook Massacre and Blood Artist punish every death while free outlets fuel the engine. For players who love grindy, board-eating value decks.

keystones: Thing in the Ice // Awoken Horror; Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration; Bedlam Reveler; Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberration
core_cards: Thermo-Alchemist; Galvanic Iteration; Burning Vengeance; Seize the Storm; Faithless Looting; Rise from the Tides; Chandra, Dressed to Kill; Jace, Unraveler of Secrets; Temporal Mastery; Mirrorwing Dragon
rationale: Flashback doubles every spell for the count-spells payoffs; Galvanic Iteration copying Temporal Mastery (cross-tag) is the haymaker.
pitch: A UR tempo-control deck that doubles every spell with flashback. Thing in the Ice and Docent of Perfection flip into threats as you chain instants and sorceries. For players who love spell-heavy decks and explosive payoff turns.

keystones: Cathars' Crusade; Second Harvest; Intangible Virtue; Wedding Announcement // Wedding Festivity
core_cards: Lingering Souls; Gather the Townsfolk; Spider Spawning; Crusader of Odric; Cryptolith Rite; Unnatural Growth; Decimator of the Provinces; Tamiyo's Journal
rationale: 44 token cards feed anthem payoffs; Unnatural Growth and Decimator (cross-tag) are go-wide finishers; Tamiyo's Journal Clues are tokens for Second Harvest.
pitch: A white-based go-wide deck that pairs a huge board with anthems. Cathars' Crusade and Intangible Virtue make your tokens lethal, and Second Harvest doubles the swarm. For players who love flooding the board and overrunning the table.

keystones: Splinterfright; The Gitrog Monster; Hermit Druid; Emrakul, the Promised End
core_cards: Ghoultree; Moldgraf Millipede; Spider Spawning; Grapple with the Past; Vilespawn Spider; Traverse the Ulvenwald; Laboratory Maniac
rationale: Payoffs scale with creature cards in yard while a dozen enablers stock it; Hermit Druid plus Laboratory Maniac is a real win line.
pitch: A BG midrange-combo deck that turns its graveyard into a resource. Splinterfright and The Gitrog Monster grow off creatures in the yard, and Hermit Druid plus Laboratory Maniac is a real combo kill. For players who like filling the bin and cashing it in.

keystones: Elder Deep-Fiend; Distended Mindbender; Decimator of the Provinces
core_cards: Wretched Gryff; It of the Horrid Swarm; Abundant Maw; Biolume Egg // Biolume Serpent; Eldritch Evolution; Heartless Summoning; Cryptolith Rite; Grizzled Angler // Grisly Anglerfish
rationale: Six cast-trigger Eldrazi eat undying/self-returning fodder; Heartless Summoning (cross-tag) discounts the fatties harmlessly.
pitch: A midrange-combo deck that cheats out Eldrazi by eating your own creatures. Emerge threats devour undying fodder to hit the board ahead of schedule. For players who like a resourceful, sacrifice-fueled ramp plan.

keystones: Restoration Angel; Conjurer's Closet; Deadeye Navigator
core_cards: Essence Flux; Fiend Hunter; Mist Raven; Spell Queller; Subjugator Angel; Cathars' Crusade; Angel's Tomb; Helvault
rationale: Four repeatable blink engines reset a cube full of ETB triggers; Helvault (fringe cross-tag) banks ETB creatures for a mass re-entry.
pitch: A WU value deck that resets enter-the-battlefield effects. Restoration Angel and Deadeye Navigator re-trigger a board full of ETB creatures for endless advantage. For players who enjoy value engines and answering everything.

keystones: Voice of the Blessed; Chalice of Life // Chalice of Death; Restless Bloodseeker // Bloodsoaked Reveler
core_cards: Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom; Blood Artist; Apothecary Geist; Gluttonous Guest; Liesa, Forgotten Archangel; Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord
rationale: Two true gain-life payoffs over repeatable incidental gain; black drain effects double-dip.
pitch: A WB midrange deck that turns steady life gain into payoffs. Voice of the Blessed and Chalice of Life reward the drain and incidental gain from aristocrats effects. For players who like a resilient, grinding game plan.

keystones: Sigarda, Host of Herons; Twinblade Geist // Twinblade Invocation; Neglected Heirloom // Ashmouth Blade
core_cards: Gryff's Boon; Faith Unbroken; Lunarch Mantle; Butcher's Cleaver; Stitcher's Graft; Demonmail Hauberk; Blood Mist; Uncaged Fury
rationale: Recursive/disturb auras dodge the 2-for-1; Sigarda's hexproof (cross-tag) is the ideal suit-up target.
pitch: A white-based deck that suits up one creature and swings for the win. Recursive auras dodge card disadvantage while Sigarda gives an unkillable target to load up. For players who like all-in single-threat beatdown.

keystones: The Gitrog Monster; Wrenn and Seven; Tireless Tracker
core_cards: Cultivator Colossus; Groundskeeper; Eccentric Farmer; Grapple with the Past; Evolving Wilds; Traveler's Amulet; Wild-Field Scarecrow
rationale: Gitrog and Wrenn convert land drops and dead lands into cards; Cultivator Colossus is the mass payoff.
pitch: A BG midrange deck that turns land drops and dead lands into cards. The Gitrog Monster and Wrenn and Seven grind value while Cultivator Colossus is the big payoff. For players who love a slow, inevitable value grind.

keystones: Torens, Fist of the Angels; Cathars' Crusade; Hopeful Initiate
core_cards: Metallic Mimic; Altered Ego; Travel Preparations; Duel for Dominance; Angelfire Ignition; Voice of the Blessed; Lumberknot
rationale: Torens' training tokens grow each other; Hopeful Initiate spends counters as removal; Mimic seeds any tribe.
pitch: A GW aggro-midrange deck that grows its team through training and coven. Torens makes tokens that pump each other and Hopeful Initiate spends counters as removal. For players who like a snowballing, synergistic board.

keystones: Griselbrand; Through the Breach; Edgar's Awakening; Bruna, the Fading Light
core_cards: Hermit Druid; Faithless Looting; Lightning Axe; Collective Brutality; Haunted Dead; Midnight Scavengers; Mass Hysteria
rationale: Edgar's Awakening reanimates anything; Breach cheats Griselbrand from hand; Mass Hysteria (cross-tag) gives the fatty haste. Breach does not cast, so cast-trigger Eldrazi get nothing.
pitch: A black combo-midrange deck that drops giants ahead of schedule. Edgar's Awakening reanimates anything and Through the Breach cheats Griselbrand from hand. For players who want explosive, game-warping early plays.

keystones: Gisela, the Broken Blade; Bruna, the Fading Light; Hanweir Garrison; Hanweir Battlements; Graf Rats; Midnight Scavengers
core_cards: Brisela, Voice of Nightmares; Hanweir, the Writhing Township; Chittering Host
rationale: All three meld pairs and their melded faces are in the cube; each half is independently playable, so meld is pure upside.
pitch: A build-around that fuses two cards into a single monster. All three meld pairs are here, and since each half plays fine alone, going for the meld is pure upside. For players who enjoy a rewarding two-card payoff.

rationale: Tree sets an opponent to exactly 13; Triskaidekaphobia's upkeep trigger then wins the game outright.
pitch: A quirky black combo that wins off an exact life total. Tree of Perdition sets the opponent to 13 and Triskaidekaphobia finishes them on your upkeep. A spicy build-around for players who love an unusual alternate win.
